name: Fire Lizard
appearance: A 30-foot lizard that resembles a wingless red dragon. It has gray scales, a back mottled with red and brown, and a reddish underside. Hatchlings are light gray and darken with age.

Combat.name: Claws and bite
Combat.effectNote: Its regular attacks are two raking claws and a bite.

Combat.name: Fiery cone
Combat.effectNote: It can breathe fire simultaneously with its claws and bite. The cone is 15 feet long, 5 feet wide at the mouth, and 10 feet wide at the end. It deals 2–12 fire damage, halved by a successful save vs. breath weapon.

Combat.name: Fire immunity
Combat.effectNote: It is immune to fire-based attacks.

Lair.name: Hunting cycle
Lair.effectNote: It sleeps about half the time and leaves its lair every fortnight to hunt. It carries prey back and collects shiny objects.

Lair.name: Eggs
Lair.effectNote: A lair has a 10% chance to contain 1–4 eggs. Young lizards leave to hunt after hatching.

notes: 1–4 appearing. Very rare. Solitary organization. Day activity. Carnivorous and neutral.
Animal intelligence (1). Treasure B, Q (×10), S, T. Steady (11–12) morale. Magic resistance Nil.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, p. 226.

name: Giant Lizard
appearance: A relatively normal lizard scaled up to 15 feet long, with a low body, four walking legs, and a long tail.

Combat.name: Jaw trap
Combat.effectNote: An attack score of 20 traps the victim in its mouth. The bite doubles to 2–16, then deals 2–16 damage each round thereafter.

Behavior.name: Swamp hunter
Behavior.effectNote: It attacks edible creatures that wander by. Black dragons share its swamps. Lizardfolk sometimes domesticate it as a mount, pack animal, or food.

notes: 2–12 (2d6) appearing. Uncommon. Solitary organization. Day activity. Carnivorous and neutral.
No intelligence (0). Treasure Nil. Average (8–10) morale. Magic resistance Nil.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, p. 226.

name: Minotaur Lizard
appearance: A 40-foot lizard with sharp claws and teeth. The male has display horns resembling those of a minotaur.

habitats: Areas near copper and red dragons

Combat.name: Ambush
Combat.effectNote: Opponents take a −5 penalty on their surprise rolls.

Combat.name: Jaw trap
Combat.effectNote: An attack roll of 20 traps the victim in its jaws. It deals 3–18 damage automatically each round thereafter until the victim escapes or dies. The victim cannot attack the following round.

Combat.name: Display horns
Combat.effectNote: The male’s horns are believed to attract a mate. Its attacks use claws and teeth.

notes: 1–8 appearing. Rare. Solitary organization. Day activity. Carnivorous and neutral.
No intelligence (0). Treasure J–N, Q, C (magic). Average (8–10) morale. Magic resistance Nil.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, p. 226.

name: Subterranean Lizard
appearance: A 20-foot lizard with suction pads on its toes for crossing walls and ceilings. Some cave forms are albino. Other forms have a long tongue.

habitats: Caves with walls and ceilings it can climb

Combat.name: Jaw clamp
Combat.effectNote: An attack roll of 20 traps the victim in its jaws and doubles the bite to 4–24. The trapped victim automatically takes 2–12 additional damage each following round.

Printed variants.name: Albino form
Printed variants.effectNote: Some forms are albino, shun light, and attack at −1 in daylight or its equivalent.

Printed variants.name: Long-tongued form
Printed variants.effectNote: Other forms have tongues up to 20 feet long. A seized man-sized or smaller victim is drawn into its mouth and bitten next round unless a bend bars roll succeeds.

Behavior.name: Cave movement
Behavior.effectNote: It can run across walls and ceilings and does not leave its cave voluntarily.

notes: 1–6 appearing. Uncommon. Solitary organization. Day activity. Carnivorous and neutral.
No intelligence (0). Treasure O, P, Q (×5). Average (8–10) morale. Magic resistance Nil.
